stories.title: U.S. rallies to win 11th straight Presidents Cup
stories.summary: The Americans won for the 11th straight time Sunday with the most lopsided singles session in Presidents Cup history.

stories.title: Bucs QB Mayfield has dislocated thumb, will undergo MRI
stories.summary: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield suffered a dislocated right thumb in the fourth quarter of Sunday's 23-16 loss to the Vikings, coach Todd Bowles said.

stories.title: Ducks QB Moore sustains concussion from hit while sliding
stories.summary: Oregon quarterback Dante Moore sustained a concussion after being hit while sliding during the second quarter of Saturday's 41-27 win over USC, head coach Dan Lanning announced Sunday.

stories.title: S. Carolina star Stewart suspended after punching Bama player
stories.summary: South Carolina star edge rusher Dylan Stewart has been suspended indefinitely after he threw a punch at an Alabama player during Saturday's loss.

stories.title: Fins on RB Achane's knee injury: 'Doesn't sound very optimistic'
stories.summary: Dolphins running back De'Von Achane suffered a knee injury against the Chiefs and was ruled out.
